name: Omon Das
subtitle: Machine Learning & Applied Statistics
bio: Omon Das is a graduate student in Statistics at the University of Chittagong, Bangladesh. As an Intern Researcher at Datakothon Research Lab, he built end-to-end ML pipelines for breast cancer mortality prediction and water quality forecasting. He served as President of the Programming Club — the university's first data-driven IT club — where he fostered a research-first culture, led workshops on R and research methodology, and established collaborative learning initiatives in applied statistics and AI. His work spans deep learning, computer vision, time-series analysis, and interpretable ML, with two papers published at ICCIT 2025 and an ongoing manuscript under revision.

projects.title: Breast Cancer Mortality Prediction Pipeline
projects.description: End-to-end ML pipeline combining CatBoost, Random Forest, and LSTM to forecast breast cancer mortality trends. Includes SHAP-based interpretability and post-hoc bias correction for evidence-based policy planning.

projects.title: Water Quality Prediction — Karnaphuli River Basin
projects.description: Hybrid ML models (XGBoost, AdaBoost, Stacking ensemble, ANN) for predicting river water salinity. Achieved ANN R² = 0.98 using secondary data from CUET's Civil Engineering Dept.

projects.title: Brain Tumor Schematic Segmentation
projects.description: Deep learning image segmentation for brain tumor detection using U-Net and CNN variants with preprocessing, augmentation, and evaluation metrics.

projects.title: Road Lane Detection Using Mask R-CNN
projects.description: Instance segmentation pipeline using Mask R-CNN with ResNet-101 backbone on custom COCO-format dataset for detecting seven categories of road lane markings.

projects.title: Rainfall Prediction with Remote Sensing Data
projects.description: Hybrid ResNet-LSTM framework for rainfall prediction using remote sensing simulated datasets with LIME-based interpretability.

projects.title: Salinity Prediction Using ANN
projects.description: Ensemble ML methods alongside deep ANN architectures for salinity prediction with comparative performance analysis.

projects.title: RNN Time-Series Classification
projects.description: Recurrent neural networks for time-series forecasting and classification tasks with sequential dataset preprocessing and imputation.

projects.title: Dimension Reduction and Clustering
projects.description: Dimensionality reduction (PCA, UMAP, t-SNE, LLE) and clustering (K-means, DBSCAN, HDBSCAN) for unsupervised learning analysis.
